<!-- Title: a conventional commit subject, about 50 to 70 characters, e.g. "fix(booking): keep the chosen slot after an error". It becomes the squash commit on main. -->

## For the maintainer

<!-- Rulings made without asking (with the reason), open questions (numbered, each with a proposal), settings to change. "Nothing" if empty. -->

## Why

<!-- The problem and the reason for this change; the squash commit carries only the title. -->

## What changed

<!-- Bullets, grouped by file or topic; only what the diff and the spec do not show. -->

## How it was checked

<!-- The commands run, with their numbers (passed, failed, skipped), and every gap. Money, rights or data: the mutation probe. The independent review's conclusion, or the self-review for docs and tooling. -->

## How to check

<!-- For the maintainer's hand check (E-12): the routes and states to open, light and dark, phone and desktop. For a fix: the exact visible change, with before and after screenshots. "Nothing visible" for plumbing. -->

Spec: <!-- docs/specs/<spec>.md, or "none" -->
Slice: <!-- D2, or "none" -->
Review: <!-- deep | evidence -->
Docs: <!-- the doc files this PR changes, or "none - <reason>" -->
